notes.title: February 2025 Update
notes.content:
[h1]Patch Notes[/h1]

PavTV
-Fixed PAVTV not showing values properly
-Fixed only saved flag not working as intended
-Fixed Bomb plant spot disappearing after end of round
-Fixed Cancel button not working as intended
-Fixed Live flag not updating correctly
-Fixed Pavlov TV not gracefully ending replays when the SND match completes
-Fixed issue with timeline bar extending beyond display bounds
-Fixed overlapping text in the search
-Fixed manually typing numbers for camera settings not working as intended
-Fixed issue with rotated SnD server showing old match as live

Pavlov TV API
-Fixed /Killfeed breaking when the viewer moves in timeline
-Fixed /PlayersPos reporting incorrect bomb state 
-Fixed /MatchEvents issue rounded with floor()
-Fixed /MatchStatus {MatchStatus}.TeamX[y].Helmet always false.
-Added avatar URL when player is referred, (shack: shackname, steam: steamid, 
-Added replayid of currently playing to match status
